acceptanceCriteria.text: Given base priority=low, A1 priority=high and B1 priority=medium, when B integrates A1, then needs_review shows low/medium/high, B/main remains B1 and no public ref is overwritten.
Given A1 deletes T1 and B1 edits T1.title, when histories merge, then needs_review retains B1 and the deleted/edited alternatives for review.

Given separate commits add T1 dependsOn T2 and T2 dependsOn T1, when Dolt merges without cell conflicts, then domain validation records dependency_cycle and leaves the prior valid live head unchanged.
Given a resolution preview binds local=B1 and incoming=A1, when incoming advances to A2, then resolve returns409 stale_review with no merge commit.

Given unresolved needs_review at12:00, when the clock reaches12:15, then plugins/status and the operator inbox show warning with ReviewId and age900s; at24h severity is critical, with at most one repeat per hour.
Given Atlas/main is blocked by review R1, when Atlas/feature publishes F2 and another project publishes X1, then both succeed while Atlas/main remains unchanged.

Given A changes title and B changes description with no domain violation, when merge runs, then both values survive; competing priority or completion edits produce needs_review instead of choosing a timestamp winner.

TR-MCP-FEDERATION-007.title: reviewed conflicts and valid merges contract
TR-MCP-FEDERATION-007.body: Review record key=ReviewId UUID; fields ProjectId,Branch,baseHeads[],localHead,incomingHead,candidateRef,conflictingCells[],validationErrors[],createdUtc,lastNotifiedUtc,resolution,actor. GET conflicts and status expose it. Resolve binds exact heads and returns409 stale_review if changed. Safe TODO policy: identical concurrent values collapse; edits to different cells may merge only if invariants pass; duplicate immutable child IDs deduplicate only when bytes agree. Status, priority, title, description, dependency deletions and same-cell disagreements always require review; no timestamp last-writer-wins. Notify immediately in status and durable operator inbox; warn at15min, escalate at24h, repeat at most hourly; no email/Slack sent implicitly. Same-branch dependent commits wait; unrelated branches/projects continue.

FR-MCP-180.title: reviewed conflicts and valid merges
FR-MCP-180.body: Conflicts and invalid merges preserve valid live data, require authorized review and remain visible with ageing while unrelated publication continues.
